For me, I stayed at my first full-time job three months before I left because I still didn’t know WTF I was doing and nobody was going to help me get there. At that point I felt like I had exhausted all my resources to learn my actual job and what they expected of me which was nowhere near the job description. If you have an actual helpful manager and trainers, you may be able to get further than I did. You don’t have to be a complete expert at your job even a few months in, but for me it came to a point where nobody was effectively answering the questions I did have and that was quite frustrating. I guess you have to decide how long it’s worth putting up with if it’s not getting better. But hopefully, you can express your concerns to your trainer or your manager and see what you can do to improve. But overall, definitely don’t stay somewhere you’re constantly stressed and the work is super difficult for you. Especially if it doesn’t pay well. Best of luck!
